items.title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers are sounding the alarm related to an active campaign in which unknown threat actors are abusing a compromised Microsoft 365 (M365) credential belonging to ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) to gain unauthorized access to customers' M365 environments. items.title: Google Fixes 10 Chrome Vulnerabilities, Including Memory Corruption Flaw Found With Claude AI
items.description: Google released a Chrome Stable security update fixing 10 vulnerabilities across Windows, Mac, and Linux, including a high-severity DOM memory corruption flaw reported by Xinyang Ge of Anthropic with Claude AI. items.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Collabora Online Flaw to Backdoor Nextcloud Servers
items.description: Hackers are exploiting a critical flaw in the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server app for Nextcloud, with users reporting web shells on compromised servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-110447, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to run operating system commands without logging in. items.title: OpenAI Confirms Its AI Model Hacked Government Website While Counting Hospital Beds
items.description: OpenAI has confirmed that an internal AI model hacked an unnamed government statistics website while trying to count hospital beds.
